# Discount Banner

`promotional/discount-banner` &middot; section-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A full-width band with the discount in large type, a headline, an optional code and a button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `discount` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline` | text |  |
| `text` | text |  |
| `code` | text |  |
| `expires` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: White text on the accent color.
- **dark**: White text on the primary brand color. Sets `background: @colors.primary`, `buttonColor: @colors.primary`.
- **urgent**: White text on the error (red) color, for real urgency. Sets `background: @colors.error`, `buttonColor: @colors.error`.
- **light**: Dark text on the surface color, with a solid button. Sets `background: @colors.surface`, `textColor: @colors.text`, `buttonBackground: @colors.primary`, `buttonColor: @colors.primaryText`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.white"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.white"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.xl @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables and text honored. | Fine. | Light variant swaps with the surface. Colored bands keep their colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/discount-banner', {
  "discount": "25% off",
  "headline": "Everything in the summer edit",
  "text": "Linen, cotton and canvas, all reduced until Sunday.",
  "code": "SUMMER25",
  "expires": "Ends Sunday at midnight",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Shop the sale",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/sale"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/discount-banner",
  "data": {
    "discount": "25% off",
    "headline": "Everything in the summer edit",
    "text": "Linen, cotton and canvas, all reduced until Sunday.",
    "code": "SUMMER25",
    "expires": "Ends Sunday at midnight",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Shop the sale",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/sale"
    }
  }
}
```
